description: This file contains utility functions for searching and querying the MAST archive for JWST data using astroquery, including specialized functions for MIRI instrument data.

methods.name: mast_query(instrument, templates, start_date, end_date, aperture=None, detector=None, filter_name=None, pupil=None, grating=None, readpattern=None, lamp=None)
methods.description: Queries MAST for JWST observation data based on various parameters, supporting multiple templates and filters.

methods.name: mast_query_miri(detector, aperture, templates, start_date, end_date)
methods.description: Specialized query for MIRI instrument data, allowing search by detector and aperture over a time range.
